scope: Read-only independent audit of the completed, frozen raw-PAQ and paragraph-16384 cells on one structurally selected 4 MiB Wikipedia region. No codec run or decode was repeated.

input.interpretation_limit: This fixed profile-selected region is not probabilistically representative and is not an untouched holdout. Its result does not establish a full-enwik9 gain.

matched_policy.initial_state: empty predictor per contiguous input, state preserved within input; no warm-up/training/external data; identical policy across ablations

physical_results.formula: total archive bytes = 29-byte outer header + 35-byte fixed metadata + PAQ payload; all paragraph rules/dictionary/descriptors/holes/literals are inside the PAQ payload

comparison.outcome: paragraph representation is larger; retain the verified raw PAQ control for this target and do not promote paragraph-16384 from this result

resources.label: wall time and sampled cgroup high-water are measured under separate physical-core lanes; cgroup high-water is a lower bound, not process peak RSS. Timing is evidence for these executions, not a hardware-independent speed ranking.

verification.native_receipt_decode_boundary: separate decode command received archive only; source and materialized range inaccessible
verification.frame_checks: both archives have CIXWUNT1 magic, expected mode, source length, transformed length, fixed metadata length, PAQ prefix, and exact outer-byte conservation

limitations_and_next_decision: This is a complete physical negative for the paragraph-16384 configuration on this one targeted region, not a rejection of all body relationship mechanisms.
No size-rejection shortcut was used: both completed native receipts performed and passed independent archive-only decode.
The separately frozen line-4096 ablation is a distinct boundary hypothesis and must be reported separately; it cannot be inferred from paragraph's result.
No portfolio selection, full-file score, package cost, Hutter score, or Prize eligibility claim follows from this audit.
